# llms.txt
# AI Hub — Claude Code reference documentation
# Publicly readable and reusable. Deliberately not search-indexed (see robots.txt) —
# that is a choice about crawlers, not a restriction on people or on you.

## What's here
- A generic Claude Code guide: install, permission modes and sandboxing, CLAUDE.md,
  context management, skills, subagents, hooks, MCP and plugins, built-in review skills,
  and token efficiency
- Downloadable markdown templates (CLAUDE.md variants, AGENTS.md, agent definitions,
  project context, session checkpoint)
- A self-contained installer for this hub's slash-command skills
- A separately-labelled personal runbook — one operator's workflow, explicitly not a requirement

## What's not here
- Credentials, API keys, server details, or private infrastructure
- Project-specific deployment configurations
- Any personally identifiable information

## Pages
/hub/ai/ — the public guide (index)
/hub/ai/workflow/ — personal runbook: one operator's workflow, labelled as opinion, not requirements

## Files
/hub/ai/files/EFFICIENCY.md — Prompting and token economics: prompting advice that is now wrong, how prompt caching works and what invalidates it, /rewind vs /compact vs /clear, cutting token use
/hub/ai/files/MULTIAGENT.md — Multiagent workflow decision guide: complexity ladder, delegation patterns, worktree recovery, agent chaining
/hub/ai/files/ONBOARDING.md — Getting started reference guide
/hub/ai/files/FIRST-SESSION.md — Interactive setup guide (paste into Claude Code and follow it)
/hub/ai/files/BOT_RULES.md — Hard rules template for project bots (worktree safety, agent reporting, deploy ownership, self-cleanup)
/hub/ai/files/SESSION_CHECKLIST.md — Session management checklist (start / during / end)
/hub/ai/files/CONTEXT.template.md — Project context template (persona, roles, architecture, current state)
/hub/ai/files/progress.md — Session checkpoint template
/hub/ai/files/CLAUDE.agent-definition.md — Subagent definition template (.claude/agents/ format: tools, model, effort)
/hub/ai/files/AGENTS.md.template — AGENTS.md standard template (cross-tool)
/hub/ai/files/CLAUDE.wordpress-tw.md — Bot template: WordPress + Tailwind dev
/hub/ai/files/CLAUDE.security-review.md — Bot template: read-only security audit mode
/hub/ai/files/CLAUDE.prompt-engineer.md — Bot template: prompt design
/hub/ai/files/CLAUDE.persona-builder.md — Bot template: expert team assembly
/hub/ai/files/install-skills.sh — Self-contained installer for this hub's slash-command skills; also registers the third-party caveman plugin (github.com/JuliusBrussee/caveman — not an Anthropic product)
/hub/ai/files/setup.sh — New machine installer. Windows / Git Bash only AND must run from inside a repo that already has .agents/skills/. Writes ~/.claude config + skill junctions. Prefer install-skills.sh, which is portable and needs no repo.

## Usage
Freely read, reference, and reuse. Attribution appreciated but not required.
